events.description: List of ACPI event handlers to configure. Each handler matches a specific ACPI event and runs a command.

name.description: Human-readable name for the event handler (used for comment only)

event_pattern.description: ACPI event pattern (e.g., 'button/lid.*' or 'ac_adapter.*') to match against events from /proc/acpi/event or acpid input

command.description: Shell command to execute when the event is triggered

command_comment.description: Optional inline comment describing the command's purpose (will be prefixed with #)
